newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi imports reach $19.2 bln in 1995.
newsitem.headline: Saudi imports reach $19.2 bln in 1995.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's imports reached 72.1 billion riyals ($19.2 billion) in 1995, the official Saudi news agency said on Wednesday.
The oil-rich kingdom's exports stood at 33.5 billion riyals in the same period, it added.
The agency did not give comparative figures for 1994.
The United States ranked first in terms of exports to Saudi Arabia, followed by Japan, the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, France, Italy, South Korea, China and the Netherlands.
